reply:
Two cozy Sheung Wan picks, both with hours and menu prices checked:

1. Chachawan — 206 Hollywood Rd. Isaan Thai, buzzy neighbourhood vibe, no service charge. Dinner daily 6–11pm (last order 10pm). Starters from $108, mains from $138, desserts from $88 [S2][S12]. Two people with a couple of starters, two mains and a shared dessert lands around $580 — comfortably inside your HKD 1000 total.

2. Samsen Sheung Wan — Thai, walk-in friendly. Dinner 6–10pm Sun–Thu, 6–11pm Fri–Sat. Dishes like charcoal chicken satay $138 and wagyu boat noodles, cocktails $92–98 [S6]. A few shared plates plus drinks for two should stay under $1000.

Gaps: Chachawan's full à la carte PDF wouldn't load, so those are starting prices only; Samsen's full dinner list was only partly visible. Honjo is nearby but I could only verify lunch pricing, not dinner, so I've left it out.
